cha-cha.definition:
n. a modern ballroom dance from Latin America; small steps and swaying movements of the hips
v. dance the cha-cha
cha-cha.translation:
n. (一种源自拉美的)三拍子舞厅舞
vi. 跳三拍子舞厅舞

cha-cha-cha.definition: n. a modern ballroom dance from Latin America; small steps and swaying movements of the hips
cha-cha-cha.translation: n. 恰恰舞（一种源自拉丁美洲节奏明快的交际舞）

cha-chas.definition:
n. a modern ballroom dance from Latin America; small steps and swaying movements of the hips

cha-chas.translation: n. 恰恰舞（一种源自拉丁美洲节奏明快的交际舞）( cha-cha的复数形式 )
